description: Harper posted a Slack draft notification for 'Work and Rest Aren't Opposites. Wiring Is.' but did not include a link to the Ghost draft in the notification message. David expected a clickable link to the draft so he could review it directly from Slack.
correction: The Slack draft notification (Step 9) must include a direct link to the Ghost draft admin page or the public preview URL. Format: https://driventodevelop.com/ghost/#/editor/post/{ghost_post_id}/. Include this as a clickable line in the notification so David can open the draft in one click.
systemic_fix: Updated Step 9 notification template in step-01-discover.md to include a Ghost draft link on every notification.
